## IRouteMetricsConfig.customLabels property

Custom labels to add to metrics

**Signature:**

```typescript
customLabels?: Record<string, string | ((request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => string)>;
```

## Default Value

`undefined`

## Remarks

Label values should come from a small, bounded set; see `maxSeries` to cap the number of label combinations.

## Example


```ts
const KNOWN_CLIENTS = new Set(['web', 'ios', 'android']);

customLabels: {
 myLabel: 'my-value',
 client: (request) => {
   const value = request.headers['x-client'];
   return typeof value === 'string' && KNOWN_CLIENTS.has(value)
     ? value
     : 'other';
 },
}
```
